guestGate.title: Sponsorship Hub
guestGate.message: Sign in to register your brand, browse high-engagement watch parties, and bid on sponsorships.

register.title: Become a Sponsor
register.description: Register your company to bid on watch parties. Hosts accept or reject each bid — a 15% platform fee applies to accepted bids.
register.errorSignIn: Sign in first to register as a sponsor.

marketplace.empty: No published events match this filter.

guestGate.title: Sponsor this party
guestGate.message: Sign in to review sponsorship terms and place a bid on this watch party.

yourBid.title: Your Bid
yourBid.body: Offer a sponsorship amount for this event. The host sees your bid and note.

platformFee.title: Platform Fee — 15%
platformFee.body: SpotSeek keeps 15% of an accepted bid. The host receives the remainder.

hostDecision.title: Host Decision
hostDecision.body: The host accepts or rejects your bid. You can cancel while it is pending.

payment.body: Charged only after the host accepts. Payments are currently in test mode — no real money moves.

bid.testNoteAccepted: Payment is processed only after the host accepts — payments are in test mode, no real charges.

sponsorProfileNeeded.body: Only registered sponsors can bid. Register your company in the Sponsorship Hub, then come back to place a bid.
